messages:
ivy: FYI — billing reported ~50 misattributed requests where Console shows project=internal-tools but introspect says project=partner-alpha. seems like header vs claim precedence mismatch after auth-proxy changes
omar: confirmed. proxy still injects `X-Project` for legacy partners and the Console display logic prefers header over validated claim
ben: that breaks quotas and cost dashboards. proposal: canonicalize attribution to validated token claim `project` when present; fallback to `X-Project` only if claim missing
ivy: agreed. add telemetry first: `project_attrib_source{source:introspect|header|none}` and `project_attrib_mismatch_total` for header!=claim. also sample mismatch traces (cap 1/sec/org) so we can audit who depends on header behavior
omar: implement in auth-exchange: compute X-Effective-Project with precedence: introspect.claim -> org-compat-toggle -> X-Project -> anonymous. org-compat-toggle preserves old header-first for whitelisted orgs
ben: Console UX: in request inspector show "Attribution: token claim (validated)" or "Attribution: header (legacy)" with link to Org Settings to flip compatibility toggle
iv y: rollout plan: feature-flag behind FF, telemetry+dashboards, 1% canary -> 10% -> full. Alerting: if `project_attrib_mismatch_total` spikes >5x baseline OR any single project's quota burn delta >20%/hour, abort
billing-oncall: we'll watch billing signals. ping 24h before canary, we want runbook and an email template for affected org admins
omar: BC notes: keep toggle ON for existing orgs by default, OFF for new orgs. deprecation: 90 days notice before changing defaults for current orgs
ben: ticketed as INF-8200, will include tests, PR checklist, dashboards and comms drafts
auth-bot: Created INF-8200: "Canonical project attribution: prefer token claims; add telemetry and org compatibility toggle" assigned to omar, ivy
ivy: moving infra links/PRs into INF-8200 to keep this thread focused
omar: starting work on the auth-exchange change and metrics. will link PR when ready
ben: I'll prepare Console toggle UI and the short help text
ivy: thanks everyone, small-impact change but important for billing correctness
ben: thanks!
